records.method: builtin image_gen; detail edit then vertical camera correction
records.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: a registered production-drawing map tile for the realistic RPG Ignis. Image 1 is the exact location/layout/crop target: one contiguous portion of the existing M01 city drawing, reprojected into the fixed world grid. Image 2 is ONLY the approved map style reference, not its geography or UI. Reconstruct Image 1 as a richly detailed photorealistic strictly VERTICAL NADIR orthographic aerial photograph. Keep every existing roof footprint, street centerline, junction, courtyard, field boundary and tree mass at exactly the same normalized image coordinates. DO NOT zoom, recenter, rotate, move buildings, redesign blocks, add/delete a road, or add a river. Streets crossing an edge must cross at the exact same position and width. All boundary features must remain registered with image 1. Improve real readable detail: separate roofs with fine muted gray slate/brown weathered shingles, crisp roof ridges, dirt lane tracks, courtyard paving patches, garden plots and subtle realistic vegetation. Roofs only, no visible vertical building walls, no visible tree trunks, no isometric camera, no toy/dollhouse/miniature style, no illustrated cartoon outlines. Keep the reference's subdued olive greens and gray/brown material values, flat diffuse daylight and very short soft shadows. No candy saturation, no new landmarks or fortifications, no huge tree, no modern cars. Preserve the source area's larger block/road configuration even when small surface details are renewed. This is a partial city tile and must NOT become a complete centered settlement. No UI, borders, grid, text, numbers or symbols. One square image, as high resolution and crisp as possible, ideally 2304 by 2304 pixels.
records.correction: Remove facade bands and use true vertical orthographic roofs-only view; preserve crop and roads.
